experiencia.descripcion_certificados_agroquimicos: Developed a web application as part of a team for the Department of Agriculture – Tobacco Division, designed to manage certificates for companies and consultants who handle agrochemicals. The system was built using React.js (front end), Node.js + Express (back end), and MySQL (database). It includes a registration module where applicants can submit information and PDF documents, download certificates, and view inspections, with or without fines. We also implemented an employee module that allows staff to manage companies and consultants, validate documentation, and generate inspection reports.
experiencia.descripcion_medico: Developed a personal website for a medical professional, designed to showcase services, specialties, contact information, and appointment booking options. Used Next.js and Tailwind CSS, incorporating responsive design, navigation, and interactive components. This project allowed me to gain practical experience with Next.js and further develop my skills in Tailwind CSS.

proyectos.descripcion_reserva_canchas: Developed a web application for booking sports courts, implementing a complete CRUD system to manage reservations, users, and schedules. Used React.js on the front end to build a dynamic and responsive interface, Node.js and Express on the back end to handle requests and server-side logic, and MySQL as the database to store information securely and efficiently.
proyectos.descripcion_reserva_restaurante: Developed a web application to manage restaurant table reservations, allowing users to select a date, time, and number of guests. Used React.js for front-end development, Node.js with Express for the back end, and MongoDB as a NoSQL database to store reservations and system configurations. Implemented complete CRUD operations, validations, and an interface focused on user experience.
proyectos.descripcion_drugstore: Built a web interface for a drugstore, focused on displaying products, categories, and simulating purchases. Development was entirely front-end using React.js, with state management, product filtering, a simulated shopping cart, and responsive design.
proyectos.descripcion_e_commerce: Developed an e-commerce website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Implemented a complete CRUD system to manage the application's information and main functionalities, along with an interface designed for product presentation and management.
proyectos.descripcion_streaming: Recreated the visual interface of the Disney+ platform using HTML and CSS, aiming to replicate its structure, content layout, and visual design through a responsive interface.
